ingredients.raw_text: 1/2 cup shredded tasty cheese Oil spray, for greasing muffin tin

method: Preheat oven to 180°C (fan-forced).
Spray 12 standard non-stick muffin holes with oil.
Whisk eggs, salt and pepper in a large bowl until well combined. Stir through spinach, ham and shredded cheese.
Divide mixture between 12 holes.
Bake for 20 minutes or until the top is light golden and cooked through. Test that a skewer comes out of the centre clean.
Allow to cool completely before storing in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days or freezer for 3 months.

title: MEDITERRANEAN ORZO
method: Heat olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add onion and cook for 2-3 minutes or until soft & translucent.
Add in dry risoni (orzo), oregano and stir to coat well. Add zucchini, stock, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, salt and pepper. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring regularly, uncovered, for 10-12 minutes or until the risoni are cooked through.
Remove from heat and stir through spinach.
Divide among serving bowls and finish with your choice of toppings. Enjoy! Note: It is recommended to serve this recipe with a source of protein, for example chicken, meat, seafood.

title: HOMEMADE MEATBALLS

ingredients.raw_text: Extra virgin olive oil, for shallow frying
1/2 bunch fresh flat leaf parsley, roughly chopped

method: Place mince, egg, onion, and breadcrumbs in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and mix well. Roll level tablespoons of mince mixture into balls.

Heat olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add meatballs, in batches, and cook for 3-5 minutes on each side until crispy on the outside and cooked through (no pink in the middle). Once cooked, pour in crushed tomatoes, soy, garlic, and parsley. Stir to combine.
Set aside to cool and serve with your

title: CHICKEN GYROS
method: In a large bowl, combine all chickenmarinade ingredients with the chicken. Set aside for 10 minutes.
In a separate large bowl, mix flour, greek yoghurt, and salt until combined. Form dough into a ball and divide into 4 portions. Flatten eachportion into a circular shape.
Heat oil over a medium heat in a large frying pan and cook each pita for 2-3 minutes or until golden on each side, flipping halfway.
Remove pitas from pan, and allow to cool slightly.
Heat the same pan over medium-high heat. Cook chicken, in batches, for 5-10 minutes or until browned. Remove from heat and set aside.
Assemble gyros by adding chickenand salad to each pita bread.
Enjoy!

title: CHICKEN CACCIATORE WITH BASMATI RICE

ingredients.raw_text: 2 cloves garlic, minced (or 1 teaspoon garlic powder)
2x 250g microwavable basmati rice pouches Black pepper, to taste

method: 5 cm pieces
Heat olive oil in a large pan over a medium heat, add chicken and cook chicken until lightly browned.
Add garlic and sliced mushrooms. Cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant and mushrooms soften.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes and chickenstock. Bring to boil and then turn heat down to a gentle simmer.
Simmer for 15 -20 minutes, until chickenis cooked through and sauce has thickened.
Add sliced zucchini and olives, cook for 5 minutes until zucchini is tender.
Stir spinach through until just wilted, turn off heat
Prepare basmati rice as per packet instructions, divide into 4 bowls.
Serve cacciatore over basmati rice.
Season with black pepper, sprinkle with parsley and parmesan cheese and serve !

title: MONGOLIAN LAMB
method: In a medium bowl, combine marinade ingredients and lamb, mixing very well. Cover and refrigerate whilst preparing your vegetables.
In a separate bowl, combine all sauce ingredients.
In a large fry pan or wok, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium to high heat. Add onion and cook, stirring, for 30 seconds until starting to colour.
Add remaining vegetables and cook for 5 minutes, or until softened. Add lamb (including marinade sauce) and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until most pieces have turned from red to brown.
Add sauce and simmer, stirring, for 1-2 minutes until thickened.
Serve with rice and top with sesame seeds (if you like)!

title: CHICKEN QUESADILLAS
method: Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium to high heat. Add capsicum and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Transfer shredded chicken, tomato paste, paprika, and spring onions to the pan. Heat up for 2 mins or until all warmed through.
Lay out wraps flat on a board or plate and spread chicken mixture across the base.
Sprinkle on spinach and cheese, and top with another wrap.
Heat sandwich press and spray with
Transfer quesadillas into the sandwich press to cook until cheese is melted and wraps are golden, about 2 minutes.
Combine greek yoghurt, lime juice, and garlic in a separate bowl to create a dipping sauce.

title: PORK BANH MI BURGERS

ingredients.raw_text: Pinch each of salt and sugar

method: In a medium bowl, combine carrot and radish. Toss through rice wine vinegar, salt and sugar and set aside to pickle.
In a separate bowl, combine pork mince, garlic, ginger, spring onion, salt and sesame oil. Mix until well combined.

Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a medium pan over medium-high heat. Divide the pork mince into 4 and roll into balls. Add the balls to the pan and flatten using the back of a spatula, and cook until golden on the bottom, about 3-5 minutes.
Flip each burger patties, flatten again and cook for a further 3-5 minutes, until golden.
Assemble the burgers by placing 1 patty on a wholemeal roll, topping with the Banh Mi Slaw, iceberg lettuce, coriander (if using) and sweet chilli sauce.
Enjoy!

title: BANANA BREAD CHOC CHIP COOKIES
method: In a large bowl, combine mashed banana, brown sugar and vegetable oil.
Add egg yolk and vanilla extract. Mix well using a wooden spoon.
Add flour, salt and cinnamon. Stir until combined well, there should be no flour remaining.
Fold in the chocolate chips, cover and set aside whilst the oven preheats.
Preheat the oven to 180°C. Line a baking tray with baking paper.
Using a tablespoon, scoop cookie dough out of the bowl and roll between your palms to form a ball. Place on the baking paper about
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the edges are set and the centre is slightly underbaked.
Allow to cool and then serve!

title: BANANA GRANOLA COOKIES

ingredients.raw_text: 100 g (1 cup) rolled oats Sprinkle of cinnamon

ingredients.prep: if want cookies crispier, can use 1 tablespoon sugar instead
ingredients.raw_text: 2 tablespoons honey (if want cookies crispier, can use 1 tablespoon sugar instead)

method: Preheat your oven to 170°C (fan-forced) and line a baking tray with baking paper.

Mash banana in a large bowl with a fork. Add the oats, cinnamon, honey and oil and mix until combined. Leave to rest on the countertop for 10 minutes, so that the oats can absorb the moisture from the other ingredients.
After 10 minutes, add in the chocolate chips (reserve a few to sprinkle on once the cookies are cooked) and salt. Stir to combine.
Roll 1 tablespoon of mixture into a ball and then squash to flatten into a thick disk (approx. 1cm thick). Place on a baking tray and repeat until all your mixture is used up.
Place in the oven and cook for 15 minutes.
Take out of the oven, sprinkle with the reserved chocolate chips and leave to cool.

title: CHEESEBURGER SAUSAGE ROLLS

ingredients.raw_text: 4 large low GI wraps (Recommend: Wholegrain or wholemeal wraps)
1 tablespoon sesame seeds Tomato or BBQ Sauce, to serve

method: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Line a baking tray with baking paper.
In a large mixing bowl, combine beef mince, grated carrot, zucchini, pickles, Worcestershire sauce, smoked paprika and shredded cheese. Add salt and pepper and mix well to combine using hands.
On a chopping board or clean bench, lay out a large wrap. Transfer some of the mince mixture onto one half of the wrap in a line.
Fold up the sides and tuck in as you fold the lengthways side up and roll into a snug burrito. Wash the top with whisked egg and sprinkle sesame seeds to finish.
Repeat until all mince mixture is used.
Bake in the oven for 25-30minutes or until wraps are golden and crispy.
Serve with your favourite dipping sauce and enjoy!

title: FLUFFY JAPANESE SOUFFLE PANCAKES
method: In a large bowl, whip the cream with powdered sugar and vanilla until soft peaks form. Set aside in the fridge until ready to serve pancakes.
Separate eggs into whites and yolks in two different bowls. Put the bowl with the egg whites in the freezer for

Meanwhile, add milk and vanilla to egg yolks and whisk until thick and frothy. Sift in cake flour and baking powder into the yolk mixture. Whisk to combine, however for not over mix. Set aside while you make the meringue.
After 15 minutes, take out the bowl with the egg whites from the freezer (they should be half frozen. Start beating the whites, gradually adding the sugar until it forms stiff peaks.
Add 1/3 of the meringue to the egg yolk mixture. Whisk together by hand. Add remaining meringue to the yolk mixture and gently fold in without breaking the bubbles.
Heat a large nonstick frying pan over low heat. Add oil to the pan and then remove any excess using paper towel.
Using a soup ladle or serving spoon, place 2 scoops of batter for each pancake on the pan (cook 3 pancakes at a time). After all pancakes have 2 scoops, add another scoop to pile up the batter.

Set a time for 6-7 minutes and add 1 tablespoon of water to the pan. Cover with a lid. Allow to cook for 2 minutes, remove the lid and add one final scoop of batter to each pancake. Replace the lid and allow to continue to cook.
After 6-7 minutes, gently flip the pancakes and add another tablespoon of water. Replace the lid and allow to cook for a further 4-5 minutes or until browned.
Remove from the pan and serve with a dollop of fresh cream. berries and maple syrup.

title: HOMEMADE CHILLI OIL

ingredients.raw_text: 700ml Canola Oil or alternative neutral oil

method: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, bring oil and aromatics to a simmer. Gently simmer for 40 minutes.
Combine the spice base ingredients in a large heat proof bowl. Strain the oil into the bowl in small amounts at a time, until all oil is mixed in.
Let the oil cool for 10-15 minutes, and then add black vinegar and sesame seeds.
Divide into jars and store in the fridge for up to 3 months.

title: KOREAN BEEF BOWLS

ingredients.raw_text: 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, plus extra to garnish
1 Lebanese cucumber, sliced into half moons

method: In a small bowl, whisk together the garlic, ginger, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, gochujang, rice vinegar and sesame seeds until combined. Set aside.

Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium– high heat. Add mince and cook until browned, about 4-5 minutes, breaking it up as it cooks. Pour in stir-fry sauce and stir well to coat the beef. Simmer for 2–3 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Turn the heat off and stir through the spring onion.
Divide the basmati rice among four bowls and/or containers. Top with the Korean beef mixture and a generous serving of kimchi, carrot and cucumber. Garnish with extra
Enjoy!

title: PICKLED VEG!

ingredients.raw_text: 1 bunch radishes (about 8–10) OR 2 red onions OR 1/2 red cabbage, thinly sliced
1/2 teaspoon whole black peppercorns A few sprigs of fresh dill or thyme

method: Wash and thinly slice the radishes (a mandoline makes it quick, but a sharp knife works fine). Place them in a clean glass jar or container.
In a small saucepan, combine the vinegar, water, sugar, and salt. Stir over medium heat until the sugar and salt have fully dissolved. This should only take 1–2 minutes. Remove from heat.
If using garlic, peppercorns, herbs, or chilli flakes, add them to the jar with the radishes now.
Pour the warm pickling liquid over the radishes, making sure they’re fully submerged. If needed, press them down with a spoon.
Let the jar cool to room temperature, then seal it and place in the fridge. The radishes will be lightly pickled in about an hour, but best after a few hours or overnight.

title: BANANA OAT MUFFINS

ingredients.raw_text: 2 large mashed ripe banana (the riper the sweeter)

method: Preheat the oven to 180°C (fan-forced) and line a 12-cup muffin tray with paper liners.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon, and salt.

In a medium bowl, whisk together the milk, oil, eggs, and vanilla until well combined. Stir in the mashed banana. Pour the milk mixture into the oat mixture and stir together until well combined. Stir in the chocolate chips, if using.
Divide the batter among the paper liners. Sprinkle with extra oats and cinnamon, if desired.
Bake for 18 - 22 minutes or until golden brown and a skewer or knife comes out of the centre clean. Let the muffins cool in the pan for a few minutes, then remove and continue cooling on a wire rack.
Enjoy!

title: JAPANESE MISO RAMEN

ingredients.prep: soft boiled Enoki mushrooms Canned corn, drained Nori, cut into quarters
ingredients.raw_text: 4 eggs, soft boiled Enoki mushrooms Canned corn, drained Nori, cut into quarters
2 Spring onions, finely sliced Homemade Chilli Oil

method: Heat sesame oil in a medium saucepan over medium-low heat. Add garlic, ginger and spring onions and cook, stirring, for 30 seconds or until fragrant,
Add mushrooms and increase the heat to medium. Once mushrooms are browned and sweating, add pork mince and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add miso paste and stir quickly to blend with the mince and mushrooms. Add sugar, sake and chicken stock and bring to a simmer. Season with salt and pepper.
Cover broth with a lid and allow to gently simmer. Meanwhile, prepare noodles per packet instructions.
Divide noodles between bowls and begin to construct your ramen bowl by adding broth and your choice to toppings such as egg, corn, enoki mushrooms, nori, spring onions and a drizzle of chilli oil.

title: HOMEMADE PIZZAS

ingredients.raw_text: 1/2 red capsicum, diced into small chunks

method: Preheat oven to 200°C and line baking trays with baking paper.
Mix flour, greek yoghurt, and salt in a large mixing bowl until combined. Form dough into a ball and divide into 4 portions.
Roll each portion into a circular shape, about
5cm thick. Transfer to the prepared baking trays.
Spread pizza paste on base of pizzas using the back of a spoon.
Top pizzas with toppings of choice, ensuring there are 3 different coloured ingredients.
Sprinkle cheese and Italian herbs over the top and place in the oven for 10-15 minutes or until base is golden and crispy and cheese has melted.
Remove to a tray and carefully slice in 6 pieces.

title: RED BEAN MOCHI

ingredients.raw_text: 1 can Adzuki beans, rinsed and drained
8 x rice paper sheets Cornstarch for dusting

method: Combine adzuki beans, sugar, and salt in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until thick. Stir in vanilla, mash until mostly smooth, and cool completely. Divide into 8 balls and chill for 20 minutes.
Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for 5–10 seconds until softened. Place a bean ball in the center and wrap tightly. For a chewier mochi texture, wrap with a second softened rice paper sheet.
Dust hands and a tray with cornstarch. Roll each mochi ball lightly in cornstarch to prevent sticking. Serve immediately or chill until ready to eat.

title: INDIVIDUAL TIRAMISU CUPS

ingredients.prep: for dusting Grated chocolate, for topping
ingredients.raw_text: 1–2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder, for dusting Grated chocolate, for topping

method: In a large bowl, whip the cream with powdered sugar and vanilla until soft peaks form.
Gently add mascarpone and fold together until smooth and creamy. Avoid over-mixing.
Quickly dip 2 ladyfingers into the cooled milk and place into a serving bowl. Repeat until 2 biscuits are at the base of each serving bowl.
Spoon a layer of the cream mixture (1/2 of the total mixture) on top of each of the biscuit layers.
Add another layer of dipped biscuits, then another layer of cream.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Before serving, dust the top with cocoa powder and a shaving of chocolate.

title: SALTED CARAMEL BLISS BALLS

ingredients.raw_text: 1/2 tsp vanilla extract good pinch salt
water if needed and blitz until well combined

method: Blitz dates until broken down.
Add remaining ingredients including a splash of
Roll into 12 balls (mixture will be slightly sticky at this stage).
Pop in the freezer to set then transfer to the fridge and enjoy!
Keep stored in the fridge.

title: CHOC COCONUT BLISS BALL

ingredients.raw_text: 2 tablespoons cacao powder or cocoa powder
water if needed and blitz until well combined

method: Blitz dates until broken down.
Add remaining ingredients including a splash of
Roll into 10 balls (mixture will be slightly sticky at this stage).
Pop in the freezer to set then transfer to the fridge and enjoy!
Keep stored in the fridge.

title: BALANCED SMASH BURGERS

ingredients.prep: drained Cos lettuce, rinsed and dried Burger Sauce
ingredients.raw_text: 1x tin sliced beetroot, drained Cos lettuce, rinsed and dried Burger Sauce
pepper. Mix with your hands to combine the sauce throughout the meat. Roll into 4 meat balls

method: In a large bowl, mix together mince, Worcestershire sauce, paprika and salt and
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a medium frying pan over medium-high heat. Place the burger meat balls on to the pan and allow them to cook for 20-30 seconds.

Place baking paper over the meat, and then using your spatula, press the meat down as flat as you can get them. Cook for 2-3 minutes and then flip and top with cheese slices right away. Allow to cook for a further 1-2 minutes, or until cheese has melted.
Meanwhile, toast burger buns in the toaster or under the grill. Prepare burger sauce and set aside.
Once patties are cooked, assemble burgers: toasted bun, meat pattie, cheese, tomato, beetroot, lettuce and a smear of sauce.

title: BEEF BURGERS

ingredients.prep: drained Cos lettuce, rinsed and dried Tomato sauce, optional
ingredients.raw_text: 1x tin sliced beetroot, drained Cos lettuce, rinsed and dried Tomato sauce, optional
slices right away. Allow to cook for a further 1-

method: In a large bowl, mix together mince, grated zuchinni, carrot, paprika and salt and pepper. Mix with your hands to combine the sauce throughout the meat. Roll into 4 meat balls.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a medium frying pan over medium-high heat. Place the burger meat balls on to the pan and allow them to cook for 20-30 seconds.
Place baking paper over the meat, and then using your spatula, press the meat. Cook for 2-
Meanwhile, toast burger buns in the toaster or under the grill.
Once patties are cooked, assemble burgers: toasted bun, meat pattie, cheese, tomato, beetroot, lettuce and add sauce.

title: CRISPY TUNA SUSHI BALLS

ingredients.prep: finely chopped Pickled ginger Panko bread crumbs
ingredients.raw_text: 2 spring onions, finely chopped Pickled ginger Panko bread crumbs
2 sheets nori, finely sliced into strips
1 baby cos, leaves washed and separated

method: 5cups cooked rice)
Bring water to the boil in a large saucepan. Add in sushi rice then reduce heat to a simmer and cover for 12minutes.
Take off the heat, fluff with a fork, and leave to rest for 5minutes covered.
In a separate bowl, combine vinegar, sugar, and salt until dissolved. Stir into warm rice and set aside to cool.
In a large bowl, mix through tuna, mayo, half of the sesame seeds, and spring onions into the rice. Stir to combine.
With wet hands, roll the mixture into 3cm x
Roll sushi balls in bread crumbs and place onto a lined air-fryer tray. Gently press the bread crumbs into the rice so they stick.
Preheat air fryer to 200°C. Spray sushi balls with extra virgin olive oil. Cook for 8–10 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crispy.
Once cooked, remove sushi balls from air- fryer. Cut in halves and place into a cos lettuce leaf. Top with pickled ginger, nori, and sesame seeds.

title: TERIYAKI SAUCE TERIYAKI CHICKEN SUSHI

ingredients.raw_text: Salt-reduced soy sauce Pickled ginger Light Kewpie mayonnaise

method: Combine all marinade ingredients and whisk together in a bowl, set aside.
Bring water to the boil in a large saucepan. Add in sushi rice then reduce heat to a simmer and cover for 12minutes.
Whilst the rice is cooking, heat a pan on medium-high heat with a drizzle of olive oil. Add chicken strips any fry until golden. Add in teriyaki sauce and coat chicken to combine and thicken.
Once the rice is cooked, take off the heat, fluff with a fork, and leave to rest for 5minutes covered.
In a separate bowl, combine vinegar, sugar, and salt until dissolved. Stir into warm rice and set aside to cool.

Using a clean board or sushi mat, lay seaweed sheets shiny side down, place rice onto seaweed, then cover with an even layer of rice (about 2/3 of the seaweed). Smooth gently with a spoon or your hands.
Layer teriyaki chicken, capsicum, cucumber, carrot, snow peas and avocado on the rice, and roll it up tightly.
Slice with a sharp knife into bite-sized pieces.
Serve sushi with sides of choice

title: GREEK CHICKEN RISOTTO

ingredients.raw_text: 1 teaspoon each dried oregano, parsley and basil leaves
500g chicken breast, sliced into schnitzel fillets
juices to the pan. Cover with a lid or foil and transfer to the oven

method: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Place all marinade ingredients together in a large bowl and whisk to combine.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and coat the chicken evenly. Set aside to marinate whilst preparing remaining ingredients.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a medium pan over medium heat.

Add chicken to the pan and cook for 3 minutes or until browned. Turn and cook for a further 3 minutes, chicken should still be pink inside at this point. Remove from the pan and allow to rest on a plate.
Using the same pan, melt butter over a medium heat. Add garlic and onion and cook for 2 minutes, or until onion is translucent.
Add zucchini and cook for a further 2 minutes, until softened.
Add rice to the pan and stir until the grains turn from white to translucent. Add 1/2 cup stock and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until mostly evaporated.
Add remaining chicken stock, milk, salt and pepper. Bring to a simmer, stirring regularly. Add chicken and chicken
Bake for 20 minutes with the lid or foil on. Remove lid/foil and cook for a further 10 minutes, or until rice and chicken are cooked.
Remove chicken from the risotto and stir through parmesan and butter.
Serve risotto with a side of chicken and enjoy!

title: BAKED LAMB RISOTTO

ingredients.raw_text: 1 teaspoon each dried rosemary, oregano and thyme leaves

method: Preheat oven to 200°C.
In a large frying pan or oven safe pot, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add lamb mince and cook, breaking up as you go, until browned (~4-5 minutes).
Add carrot, zucchini, and mushrooms and stir to combine for 2-3 minutes until vegetables start to soften.
Add tomato paste, garlic, herbs and rice to the pan, and stir to combine until fragrant, about 1-2 minutes.
Add water and vegetable stock pot to the pan and bring to a boil. Once boiling, if in a pan transfer to an oven safe baking dish.
Cover with a lid OR foil and bake until all liquid is absorbed and rice is ‘al dente’, about 25-30 minutes.
Stir through butter and half the parmesan cheese. Adjust seasoning as necessary. Serve and add an extra sprinkle of cheese!

title: CHICKEN & MUSHROOM RISOTTO
method: Warm the stock in a large saucepan.

Meanwhile, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook, continuously tossing for about 4-5 minutes or until outsides are golden brown. Remove to a bowl and set aside.
Add the mushrooms and cook, continuously stirring, for about 3 minutes.
Add rice to the pan; cook and stir until rice is coated with oil and pale, golden in colour, about
Add 1/2 cup warm stock to the rice, and stir until the broth is absorbed.
Continue adding broth, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring constantly, until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender, yet firm to the bite, about 15 to 20 minutes. Add chicken back into the pan.
Stir in butter, chives, lemon zest, spinach, peas and parmesan cheese and stir until spinach is wilted and chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve in a dark, shallow bowl.

title: CHICKEN & QUINOA FRITTERS

ingredients.raw_text: 200g firm feta, crumbled (Recommend: Greek style feta)

method: Cook quinoa per packet instructions. Set aside to cool for 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine chicken mince, quinoa, kale, feta, eggs, lemon zest, mint and parsley. Season with salt and pepper and mix well to combine.
Shape 1/3 cup portions of the chicken mixture into balls and flatten to make patties.
Heat olive oil in a medium frying pan over medium heat. Cook the patties in batches, for 4 minutes on each side or until golden and cooked all the way through.
Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days or in the freezer for 3 months.

title: MISO MUSHROOM SOUP

ingredients.raw_text: 400g mixed mushrooms of choice (brown, enoki, oyster), sliced
Salt flakes and cracked pepper to taste

method: On medium heat, sauté onions in a large saucepan until soft.
Stir in mushrooms and cook for 2-3minutes until soft. Once they are caramelising, add in minced garlic, and white wine.
When the white wine has partially evaporated, add in flour, stock, miso paste and dijon mustard. Stirring as you add these ingredients in gradually to combine.
Let this sit, and simmer for 15minutes.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a small pan and add in enoki mushrooms to cook until brown in colour and crispy in texture.

Alongside this, make toastie by spreading caramelised onion chutney onto one sourdough slice and spreading mustard onto the other. Top with cheese slices and transfer into a greased sandwich press. Cook until bread is golden and crispy.
Once the stock in the soup has reduced slightly, sprinkle over smoked paprika, stir through sour cream and top with fresh parsley.
Divide into serving bowls and top with crispy enoki and more fresh parsley alongside your delicious toastie.

title: CHICKEN MUSHROOM SOUP

ingredients.raw_text: 400g mixed mushrooms of choice (brown, enoki, oyster), sliced
Salt flakes and cracked pepper to taste

method: On medium heat, sauté onions in a large saucepan until soft.
Stir in chicken and mushrooms and cook for
When the chicken is cooked, add in flour, stock, miso paste and dijon mustard. Stirring as you add these ingredients in gradually to combine.
Let this sit, and simmer for 15minutes.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a small pan and add in enoki mushrooms to cook until brown in colour and crispy in texture.

Alongside this, make toastie by spreading caramelised onion chutney onto one sourdough slice and spreading mustard onto the other. Top with cheese slices and transfer into a greased sandwich press. Cook until bread is golden and crispy.
Once the stock in the soup has reduced slightly, sprinkle over smoked paprika, stir through sour cream and top with fresh parsley.
Divide into serving bowls and top with crispy enoki and more fresh parsley alongside your delicious toastie.

title: CHICKEN PARMI BAKE

ingredients.raw_text: 500g chicken breast, sliced into thin schnitzels
4 low carb potatoes, cut into wedges

method: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Grease a large baking dish with olive oil.

Cover base with crushed tomatoes and transfer chicken breast slices on top. Place a mozzarella slice on each chicken slice, scatter spinach leaves, and place tomato vine in the middle of the dish. Season with salt and
Place baking dish into the oven and bake for 25-30minutes until chicken is cooked.
Meanwhile, transfer potato wedges in air fryer and cook for 10minutes on 200°C or until golden and crispy.
Remove baking dish from oven.
Serve a chicken parmi on a plate along with a handful of potato wedges and dressed rocket leaves.

title: TOFU CHOC MOUSSE
method: Transfer all ingredients into blender.
Blend until all combined and smooth in consistency.
Place in the freezer for 15minutes or fridge for 1hour until desired mousse consistency achieved.

title: TOFU STRAWBERRY MOUSSE
method: Blend strawberries for 60-90 seconds or until smooth. Pass strawberry mixture through a sieve to remove seeds and any lumps.
Transfer all ingredients into the blender (including strawberry mixture).
Blend until all combined and smooth in consistency.
Pour mixture into small bowls or glasses. Chill in the fridge for at least 1 hour to firm up and for the flavour to develop.

title: HOMEMADE SAUSAGE ROLLS

ingredients.raw_text: 4 large low GI / high protein wraps

method: In a large mixing bowl, combine beef mince, diced onion, grated carrot and zucchini. Add salt and pepper and mix well to combine using hands.
On a chopping board or clean bench, lay out a large wrap. Transfer some of the mince mixture onto one half of the wrap in a line.
Fold up the sides and tuck in as you fold the lengthways side up and roll into a snug burrito. Wash the top with whisked egg and sprinkle sesame seeds to finish.
Repeat until all mince mixture is used.
Air-fry on 200°C for 12minutes or until wraps are golden and crispy.
Serve with your favourite dipping sauce and enjoy!

title: POTATO & LEEK SOUP

ingredients.prep: white and pale green parks only, thinly sliced
ingredients.raw_text: 3 leeks, white and pale green parks only, thinly sliced

ingredients.prep: finely chopped, to garnish Crusty wholemeal/wholegrain, bread, to serve!
ingredients.raw_text: 3/4 cup greek yoghurt OR light cream OR cottage cheese Chives, finely chopped, to garnish Crusty wholemeal/wholegrain, bread, to serve!

method: 5L vegetable stock, salt reduced
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add leeks and cook, stirring, for 7-10 minutes until soft.

Add potatoes and stock to the pan and increase heat to medium-high to bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, with lid on, for 25 minutes or until potatoes are very soft and almost falling apart.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and puree with a stick blender until just smooth. Add salt and pepper and stir through.
Add in greek yoghurt/light cream/cottage cheese and stir until combined.
Serve with a slice of crusty bread and chives. Enjoy!

title: POTATO & TOMATO SOUP

ingredients.prep: white and pale green parks only, thinly sliced
ingredients.raw_text: 3 leeks, white and pale green parks only, thinly sliced

ingredients.prep: finely chopped, to garnish Crusty wholemeal/wholegrain, bread, to serve!
ingredients.raw_text: 3/4 cup greek yoghurt OR light cream OR cottage cheese Chives, finely chopped, to garnish Crusty wholemeal/wholegrain, bread, to serve!

method: 5L vegetable stock, salt reduced

title: QUESADILLAS

ingredients.raw_text: 1 tablespoon of each, garlic powder & smoked paprika
1 carrot, shaved using peeler or grated

method: Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium to high heat. Add onion and cook for 2-3 minutes or until translucent and fragrant. Add beef mince and cook, breaking up lumps until all browned. Add garlic powder, paprika and salt and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Lay out wraps flat on a board or plate and lay a flat layer of beef mince across the base.
Top with an even layer of vegetables, spinach and cheese. Top with another wrap and press down gently to flatten.
Heat sandwich press and spray with olive oil.

title: HOMEMADE BEEF BURGERS
method: In a large frying pan over medium heat, add onions and cook for 8-10 minutes or until softened. Add balsamic vinegar and brown sugar and continue cooking for a further 5 minutes or until caramelised and sticky. Remove to a bowl and clean pan.

Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine mince, breadcrumbs, egg, Worcestershire sauce, tomato sauce, salt and pepper. Use your hands to combine well. Divide the mixture into 4 portions, and use form patties.
Return the pan to a medium-high heat and add olive oil. Cook patties for 10–12 minutes, turning once halfway through. Remove to a plate to rest and place slice of cheese on top to melt.
Construct burgers by spreading mustard on base of burger, topping with salad, patty with cheese and pickles.

Roast for 30 minutes, or until pumpkin is brown and soft, tossing once at the mid way mark.

title: GRILLED LAMB STEAK WITH ROAST VEG COUS COUS

ingredients.raw_text: 1 teaspoon each of dried oregano, parsley and basil

method: Preheat oven to 200°C (fan-forced) and line a large tray with baking paper.
Place all vegetables on the tray, add herbs and 2 tablespoons olive oil. Season with salt and pepper and mix, using your hands, to combine. Roast in the oven for 35 minutes.
Meanwhile, put cous cous in a large bowl, pour over the stock and cover, then set aside for 10 minutes, Fluff with a fork once done.

Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a medium pan over medium-high heat. Add lamb steaks to the pan, season with salt and pepper, and cook for 4 minutes on both sides. Set aside to allow to rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
In a small bowl, combine lemon juice, wholegrain mustard, 1 tablespoon olive oil and salt & pepper. Mix through mint leaves.
Add cous cous and salad dressing to a large bowl with the roasted vegetables, and toss gently to combine. Serve with lamb steak and enjoy!

title: PRAWN DUMPLING STIR FRY

ingredients.raw_text: 1 large packet prawn dumplings (Recommend Prawn Gyoza)

method: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil and cook vermicelli noodles as per packet instructions. Rinse under cold water and drizzle sesame oil over to prevent from sticking. Set aside.
Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add dumplings, cooking for 2-3 minutes per side, cooking in batches of 6-8. Rotate pieces until crisp on all sides. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of oil and add vegetables. Cook, stirring, for 3-5 minutes or until softened. Add noodles and dumplings to the pan.
In a small bowl, whisk together the dressing ingredients until combined.
Add the dressing to pan and combine using tongs to gently toss it all together.
Divide stir fry among bowls or containers.
Sprinkle sesame seeds on top and enjoy!

method: Preheat oven to 180°C (fan-forced) and line a tray with baking paper. Place the wrap on the tray.

Finish with rocket leaves  and cut into 8 slices.

Meanwhile, cook vermicelli noodles per packet instructions. Transfer noodles to a large bowl.

title: SMOKED SALMON OKONOMIYAKI

ingredients.raw_text: 4 spring onions, white and greens thinly sliced

method: Combine flour, baking powder and salt in a large bowl and mix to combine.
Combine eggs and stock in a separate bowl and mix until well combined.
Make a well in the centre of the dry ingredients and pour in the wet mixture. Gently fold together until a batter is formed.
Add cabbage, mushrooms, spring onion and half the smoked salmon into the batter and mix well.
Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes and whisk together Okonomiyaki sauce ingredients in a separate bowl.

Heat olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Pour all of the batter into the pan. Spread out and ensure in a circular shape and evenly distributed. (Note: You want the heat high enough to create a crisp but not too hot that it burns before setting the batter enough to flip). If available, place the lid on the frying pan and cook for 5-6 minutes on one side. Carefully flip and continue to cook for 3-4 minutes or until golden and cooked through.
Remove to a plate, spread over sauce and remaining smoked salmon.
Top with additional toppings and enjoy!
